title: Sahaja Yoga
description: Sahaja Yoga is a unique method of meditation based on the experience of Self-realisation through Kundalini Awakening. It establishes a deep state of inner silence and joy, where one experiences the deepest self, free from unhelpful thoughts, anxieties and worries. It is free and everyone is welcome to join.

title: Zumba
description: Get moving, have fun, and keep fit with our Free Zumba Classes! Join us for an energising workout that combines lively music with easy-to-follow dance moves. No experience needed, just bring your enthusiasm and a smile!

title: English Session
description: The Free English Sessions for Senior Citizens aim to support elderly members of our community who face difficulties with the English language. These sessions provide a comfortable and understanding environment where participants can learn useful communication skills, improve confidence, and engage more easily in daily life. The focus is on practical English for real situations, with patient guidance and a friendly atmosphere.

title: Wonderful Wednesday
description: Feeling a bit lonely or isolated? Come and join our friendly get-together designed to bring people together for a chat, laughter, and companionship. Enjoy good company, light activities, and a delicious free lunch in a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

title: Yoga
description: Take a break from your busy routine and join our relaxing Free Yoga Classes! These sessions focus on gentle movements, stretching, and breathing exercises to help improve flexibility, balance, and peace of mind. Come along, unwind, and feel refreshed - no experience needed. Just bring a mat and a smile!

title: Art Therapy
description: Join our fun and creative Art Programme for children! This free programme encourages young artists to express themselves through drawing, painting, and craft activities. It's a great way for children to explore their imagination, build confidence, and make a new friend in a supportive environment. All materials are provided - just bring your creativity!

title: Health & Wellbeing Hub
description:
Take care of your health and learn valuable skills with our Free Health Sessions held at the community hall. 
Every 2nd Saturday: Basic Life Support (BLS) Training - Learn essential life-saving skills and how to respond in an emergency.
Every 4th Saturday: Health Awareness Programme - Receive free Blood Pressure and Blood Sugar checks, along with practical advice on healthy living and wellbeing.
Everyone is welcome - come along, learn, and look after your health in a friendly community setting!

title: Music Lessons
description:

All are welcome - come along and keep our rich musical heritage alive!

Whether you're a beginner or already familiar with traditional instruments, this is a wonderful opportunity to learn, play, and connect with others who share a love for Nepalese music.
All are welcome - come along and keep our rich musical heritage alive!

title: Nepali Class
description: The Nepali Language and Culture Centre's Nepali Class aims to preserver and promote Nepal's linguistic and cultural heritage among younger generations. Children learn to speak, read, and write in Nepali through interactive lessons and engaging activities. The programme also introduces them to Nepalese traditions, festivals, and values, helping to strengthen their cultural identity and sense of belonging.

title: Sahaja Yoga
description: Sahaja Yoga is a unique method of meditation based on the experience of Self-realisation through Kundalini Awakening. It establishes a deep state of inner silence and joy, where one experiences the deepest self, free from unhelpful thoughts, anxieties and worries. It is free and everyone is welcome to join.

title: Zumba
description: Get moving, have fun, and keep fit with our Free Zumba Classes! Join us for an energising workout that combines lively music with easy-to-follow dance moves. No experience needed, just bring your enthusiasm and a smile!

title: English Session
description: The Free English Sessions for Senior Citizens aim to support elderly members of our community who face difficulties with the English language. These sessions provide a comfortable and understanding environment where participants can learn useful communication skills, improve confidence, and engage more easily in daily life. The focus is on practical English for real situations, with patient guidance and a friendly atmosphere.

title: Wonderful Wednesday
description: Feeling a bit lonely or isolated? Come and join our friendly get-together designed to bring people together for a chat, laughter, and companionship. Enjoy good company, light activities, and a delicious free lunch in a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

description:
Take care of your health and learn valuable skills with our Free Health Sessions held at the community hall.
